thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — onboarding Sylph-XL-3 with AsterCloud (marketplace) and VertexEdge (HW+SI). Need final call on distribution rights: do we allow partner-hosted quantized artifacts or only signed runtime bundles with authenticated kernel downloads?
Quinn Li: I prefer signed runtime bundles + partner-auth downloads for kernels. Keeps marketplace payload small and gives us control over provenance.
Hana Ito: VertexEdge requests the ability to ship a derived appliance image that includes the quantized model. They won't accept a runtime-only API model.
Marco Ruiz: Marketplace constraints: Azure and GCP prefer <8GB uploads. AWS can host larger but EULA fields vary. Suggest core bundle (model+runtime shim) in marketplace and link kernel packs from partner site.
Sasha (Legal): Legal position: default = partners may distribute integrated, quantized runtime artifacts only. If VertexEdge wants to embed the artifact in an appliance image, add a limited redistribution clause with audit rights and export-control clearance. I'll draft language.
Priya Nair: Marketing asks: approved messaging must avoid saying "raw weights" or "on-device checkpoint". We'll use "optimized, signed runtime bundles" in copy. Need logo approvals by 2024-06-01 for a 06-15 announcement.
Maya Patel: Proposed owners: Quinn = marketplace packaging & upload workflow, Hana = VertexEdge delivery spec + test matrix, Marco = kernel hosting plan, Sasha = legal addendum, Priya = PR + logos. Timeline: legal draft 05-18, marketplace gating 05-20, test image by 05-24.
Quinn Li: I'll open vendor tickets for Azure/AWS/GCP and confirm EULA text boxes. Will report back by EOD.
Hana Ito: VertexEdge: will run 2 SKUs — edge-mini (v1) and edge-pro (v2). For v1 we need a reduced perf profile. I'll add compatibility tests to the matrix.
Marco Ruiz: We'll publish a manifest schema with kernels[] and hw_compat fields and sign it. Large kernel packs will be behind a signed URL that requires VertexEdge partner credentials.
Sasha (Legal): Draft clause excerpt I'll include: "Partner may distribute integrated, quantized runtime artifacts and appliance images that contain those artifacts if Partner agrees to audit rights, export control review, and an additional indemnity schedule."
deploy-bot: provisioned test image sylph-xl3-q4-test-20240516, TTL 5 days.
Priya Nair: I'll prepare a short PR blurb using approved phrasing and upload logos to the shared drive; will ask legal for final signoff on wording.
Maya Patel: Good progress. We'll use this thread as the decision log. Follow-up sync 05-21 to confirm legal and marketplace gating. Thanks everyone.
